editorial_thesis: The strongest signals this week sit at the extremes of trust: attackers’ agents completed a real zero-day discovery loop, a 17M-line Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis was community-verified, and local open models plus parallel-agent tooling made private, reviewable execution practical.

topic_groups.selection_rationale: A machine-verified proof of the Riemann Hypothesis landed this week, and the verification story, not the mathematics, is the transferable pattern: independent recomputation, isolated claims, and immutability at 17M-line scale.
